description:
Numerical verification data and scripts for stress-driven shape optimization of moving trimmed shell connections. The archive contains manufactured shell results, open-joint models, reconstructions of a single-edge cantilever and a flat T-beam benchmark, and ship-frame records for the corrected endpoint norm, stress recovery, discrete sensitivities, and support-penalty checks.

The ship-frame evidence includes the matched analytic and central-difference continuation from a common prepared design, the stationarity comparison from a straight frame, a separately selected first-feasible IGA shape, and paired finite element checks at a fixed reference geometry.

The README indexes the files and verification commands. The small-model scripts reassemble and solve their specified examples. The ship-frame scripts check archived responses and geometry. Solving a new full frame requires the original CAD assembly and compatible solvers.
